purpose: Aggressively test five attractive minimum-service-unit patterns against incumbent reality before allowing any founder action.
scan_principle: A small service unit is not whitespace when an incumbent already routes, verifies, accepts and settles that unit.
Do not create a narrower story merely to preserve a candidate.

candidates.title: Short-duration / elastic warehouse capacity routing
candidates.reality_change: More shippers and smaller merchants need flexible overflow capacity rather than long fixed warehouse leases.
candidates.actor_a: shipper / merchant needing temporary or elastic storage
candidates.actor_b: warehouse operator with rentable or idle capacity
candidates.current_workaround: flexible local warehouse rental, cloud-warehouse operators, fulfillment providers and public warehouse marketplaces
candidates.minimum_service_unit: short-duration capacity instead of a full long-term lease
incumbent_evidence: 全国数智化云仓企业公共服务平台 aggregates warehouse capacity, publishes available space, and automatically matches shipper requirements to warehouse providers.
The same platform reports thousands of cloud-warehouse enterprises and large available rental capacity across hundreds of cities.
Current Xuzhou-facing warehouse providers explicitly advertise flexible rental and seasonal space adjustment.
candidates.missing_edge: NONE PROVEN at the generic routing layer
candidates.reachability: A/B in principle, but irrelevant because the generic bridge already exists

rooter_execution_map.task_unit: reserve a bounded amount of warehouse capacity for a bounded period
rooter_execution_map.acceptance: space available, goods received, inventory/handling evidence
rooter_execution_map.operator_role_if_attempted: capacity normalization, matching, booking and settlement
rooter_execution_map.operator_non_role: do not own or operate warehouses
rooter_execution_map.why_rooter_is_not_needed: existing cloud-warehouse platforms already perform the core matching and resource-utilization function

candidates.promotion_condition: Only reopen for a named Xuzhou/Jiangsu cargo class where existing flexible/cloud-warehouse routes systematically refuse the exact short-duration unit and the refusal creates measurable cost.

candidates.title: PLC / industrial-equipment diagnosis and repair microtasks
candidates.reality_change: Factories increasingly expect remote diagnosis and rapid local service rather than waiting for one OEM engineer.
candidates.actor_a: factory or equipment owner with downtime / fault pressure
candidates.actor_b: independent industrial engineer / repair provider seeking service orders
candidates.current_workaround: industrial service marketplaces, remote-maintenance systems, engineer bidding/dispatch networks
candidates.minimum_service_unit: one fault diagnosis / remote session / on-site repair order
incumbent_evidence: 云维保 lets enterprises publish service orders, matches engineers, supports engineer quoting, standardized service records and repair history.
工业速派 states that it integrates nationwide offline service stations and professional engineers for industrial service demand.
驼驮维保 advertises nationwide repair matching, engineer supply, bidding and tracked work orders.
candidates.missing_edge: NONE PROVEN at generic diagnosis / repair routing
candidates.reachability: A/B in many cities, but generic reachability is not whitespace

rooter_execution_map.task_unit: one bounded diagnosis or repair work order
rooter_execution_map.acceptance: fault resolved or diagnostic output accepted
rooter_execution_map.operator_role_if_attempted: skill graph, dispatch, work-order evidence, settlement
rooter_execution_map.operator_non_role: do not personally troubleshoot PLCs or become a repair shop
rooter_execution_map.why_rooter_is_not_needed: multiple incumbents already implement matching, dispatch, engineer identity, work-order tracking and service history

candidates.promotion_condition: Only reopen for a named failure class that current industrial-service networks repeatedly cannot route because of a specific interface, credential, acceptance or time-to-value constraint.

candidates.title: Independent used construction-machinery inspection
candidates.reality_change: Remote and export buyers need trustworthy condition evidence before paying for expensive used machinery.
candidates.actor_a: remote buyer / exporter buying used heavy equipment
candidates.current_workaround: specialist inspection firms, marketplace inspectors, broker/dealer inspection reports
candidates.real_cost: Specialist inspection providers explicitly sell per-machine inspections; fraud/mismatch risk is the buyer-side economic reason for purchase.
incumbent_evidence: 铁甲二手机 opens paid equipment inspection to the industry, offers online inspection from 300 RMB, and operates an expert/broker network with Chinese/English reports.
Mevas sells independent on-site used-machinery inspections in China with per-machine pricing and condition reports.
SGS offers remote industrial inspection with recorded video/photo evidence and expert participation.
candidates.missing_edge: NONE PROVEN at generic inspection / evidence layer
candidates.reachability: A/B around Xuzhou's machinery cluster, but incumbents already span the transaction

rooter_execution_map.task_unit: inspect one identified machine before payment/shipment
rooter_execution_map.acceptance: serial identity + condition checklist + photos/video + report
rooter_execution_map.operator_role_if_attempted: scope, inspector routing, evidence schema, acceptance, settlement
rooter_execution_map.operator_non_role: do not become the inspector or equipment dealer
rooter_execution_map.why_rooter_is_not_needed: specialist providers already sell exactly this bounded task

candidates.promotion_condition: Only reopen for a named equipment subtype or transaction stage that current inspection providers explicitly do not cover and where buyers still incur measurable travel/fraud/delay cost.

candidates.title: Local photo / fact / address verification microtasks
candidates.reality_change: Remote organizations often need a small amount of trustworthy physical-world evidence without sending employees.
candidates.actor_a: enterprise needing a location, merchant, asset or field fact verified
candidates.actor_b: local gig worker / verifier with spare time
candidates.current_workaround: nationwide field-data crowdsourcing and local verification networks
candidates.minimum_service_unit: one location visit with a prescribed evidence packet
candidates.real_cost: One current vendor case states bank enterprise-address verification previously exceeded 500 RMB per visit and averaged five days before being moved to a crowdsourced network.
incumbent_evidence: 有活 publishes an enterprise-address verification case using 1,200 local verifiers across 300 cities with standardized on-site photo/check-in/report workflow.
拍拍赚 reports a nationwide crowdsourcing network for channel/store verification and data audit.
Multiple consumer-facing crowdsourcing apps already pay users for location-bound photo and information collection tasks.
candidates.missing_edge: NONE PROVEN at generic local-fact routing
candidates.reachability: A technically, but low-friction incumbent networks already exist

rooter_execution_map.acceptance: required images/data + location/time evidence + audit pass
rooter_execution_map.operator_role_if_attempted: task schema, routing, anti-fraud, QA, settlement
rooter_execution_map.operator_non_role: do not personally travel to collect evidence
rooter_execution_map.why_rooter_is_not_needed: this control-plane pattern is already implemented directly by existing crowdsourcing vendors

candidates.promotion_condition: Only reopen for a specialized evidence packet requiring skill/acceptance that generic field-crowd networks cannot supply and where a named payer still uses an expensive workaround.

candidates.title: Independent acceptance/testing for small outsourced software projects
candidates.reality_change: Small firms increasingly buy software in short fixed-price projects and need to decide whether deliverables are acceptable before final payment.
candidates.actor_b: independent QA / senior engineer with spare review capacity
candidates.current_workaround: freelance testing services, outsourcing platforms with escrow/milestones, formal third-party test labs
candidates.minimum_service_unit: one bounded acceptance/test pass rather than a large formal certification project
incumbent_evidence: 猪八戒 already lists testing-service transactions from small fixed-price units upward.
程序员客栈 has thousands of testing freelancers and explicitly supports staged acceptance and escrow before developer settlement.
Formal third-party software labs sell independent acceptance testing with structured reports for buyers that need stronger authority.

rooter_execution_map.acceptance: test checklist, defect list, evidence and bounded pass/fail opinion
rooter_execution_map.operator_role_if_attempted: scope, reviewer routing, evidence schema, acceptance and settlement
rooter_execution_map.operator_non_role: do not personally test every project or impersonate a CMA/CNAS laboratory
rooter_execution_map.why_rooter_is_not_needed: small-unit QA supply and escrow/acceptance infrastructure already exist; narrowing to off-platform buyers alone would be story-preservation without payer evidence

candidates.promotion_condition: Only reopen if a named off-platform buyer recently paid meaningful rework/dispute cost specifically because existing freelance testing, escrow and formal test routes were unusable for one bounded acceptance decision.

current_best_next_truth: Continue scanning for a residual where both sides already move but incumbent services do not already provide routing + trust + acceptance + settlement. Do not spend founder time on the five closed generic routes in this scan.
